tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang dang brgyud bshad man ngag dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad bzhugs/

na mo gu ru bhe ra wa ya/ dpal ldan ye shes rnam lnga'i rang snang las/ / zab gsal dbyer med 'jam dpal khro bo'i sku/ /'jigs mdzad chen po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / rgyal ba'i yum chen rdo rje be ta li/ /lung bstan mchog brnyes grub chen lā li ta// thugs rjes dregs pa 'bul mdzad a mo gha/ /gsol ba= /rim gnyis mngon gyur ye shes 'byung gnas dang*/ /mngon spyod rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag pad+ma pa/ / log lta'i rgyal po tshar gcod bha ro'i zhabs/ /gsol ba= /'jigs mdzad go 'phang mchog brnyes rdo rje grags/ /lam bzang bstan pa rgyas mdzad chos rab dpal/ /zab mos rgyud sbyangs ye shes seng ge'i zhabs/ /gsol ba= /blo ldan nus pa'i dbang phyug 'bum seng dang*/ /glog skya'i rigs 'khrung rton pa dbang drag mtshan/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang ldong ston shes rab dpal/ /gsol ba= /dam chos 'khor los bsgyur ba 'phags pa'i mtshan/ /chos brgyad rnam rtog kun spangs dkon mchog dpal/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dpal/ /gsol ba= /mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /yon tan kun ldan byang chub seng ge'i zhabs/ /bsdu dngos rnam bzhis don mdzad shar chen pa/ /gsol ba= /mtshan mchog don dang ldan pa'i kun dga' bzang*/ /rgyal sras gzhan phan mngon gyur kha phyar ba/ /'jam dpal dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen shākya'i mtshan/ /gsol ba= / yang na chos rab kyi rjes su ra shang ba nas brgyud kyang rung ste/ 'di ltar/ rgyud sde kun sbyangs dkon mchog seng ge'i zhabs/ /man ngag kun gyi mdzod 'dzin chos seng pa/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mnga' bdag shes rab mtshon/ /gsol ba= /'khrul med lam bzang mngon gyur dbang phyug grags/ / rdo rje grags pa'i rnam 'khrul rgya ston rje/ /ris med thos pas brgyud phyug bag ston pa/ /'jigs mdzad zhal gzigs 'jam dbyangs ral gri'i zhabs/

/ gnas lnga mthar son blo brtan bzhi pa dang*/ /'jam dpal dgyes pa'i ye shes shākya'i mtshan/ /gsol ba= / zhes brjod kyang rung ngo*/ / mkhas dbang chos nyid mngon gyur byams gling ba/ spyod 'chang rnam 'phrul kun dga' grol mchog zhabs/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos kun dga' rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba= /rab gsal mtshan dpes spras pa rdo rje sku/ /rab mnyen yan lag drug cu'i gsung dbyangs can/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i zung 'jug thugs kyi dngos/ / gsol ba= /dbang bzhi rim pas rang rgyud smin byas te/ /zhi khro rnam par rol pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /'jam dpal khro bo'i bskyed rim mthar phyin nas/ /las dang dngos grub 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zab dang rgya che zung 'jug rim pa yis/ /snang stong dbyer med lha sku lam khyer dang*/ /dhu tir gnad du bsnan pa'i bde chen gyis/ /rdzogs rim ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bsnyen pa'i rim pas rang rgyud sbyangs byas te/ /sgrub pa'i tshul gyi rim pa mngon gyur nas/ / dngos grub rnam gnyis len pa'i las sbyor gyis/ /'jigs mdzad dngos su 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas rang don mthar phyin nas/ /mtha' dag 'gro kun theg mchog lam la bkod/ /sa dang lam rim thams cad bsgrod gyur nas/ /bla med byang chub thob par byin gyis rlaubs/ / zhes 'jigs byed rwa lugs ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang dang*/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad 'di ni/ sa skyong gzhon nu kun dga' bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 150 -- PAGE 151 -- PAGE 149 -
